name: Lavalink
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Lavalink is a standalone audio node that plays music for Discord bots, so the audio never reaches the bot's own process. The egg sets it up with a random password and the YouTube plugin.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Lavalink: downloads Lavalink.jar from Lavalink's GitHub releases and
# checks it against GitHub's checksum. application.yml, plugins and logs
# are never touched once they exist; the jar is only replaced once the new
# one has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=lavalink-devs/Lavalink
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# GitHub releases, through the installer's gh-release (GitHub's API has a
# low anonymous limit). gh_tag <latest|tag> prints the release's tag;
# returns 1 when there's no such release, 2 when GitHub can't be reached.
gh_tag() {
    local out
    out=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$1" 2>&1) && { echo "$out"; return 0; }
    case "$out" in *"has no release"* | *"no releases"*) return 1 ;; *) return 2 ;; esac
}
offline="GitHub can't be reached right now, or is limiting downloads. Reinstall to try again in a few minutes."
version="${VERSION:-latest}"
rc=0; tag=$(gh_tag "$version") || rc=$?
if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then
    latest=$(gh_tag latest) || fail "$offline"
    fail "Lavalink has no version $version. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest."
fi
[ "$rc" = 0 ] || fail "$offline"
version=$tag
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$version") || fail "$offline"
sum=$(awk '$1 == "Lavalink.jar" { print $2; f = 1 } END { exit !f }' <<<"$assets") ||
    fail "Lavalink $version has no Lavalink.jar to download. Choose another version."

if [ "$sum" != - ] && [ -f Lavalink.jar ] && [ "$(sha256sum Lavalink.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Lavalink $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Lavalink $version"
    # gh-release replaces the jar only once the new one has arrived and checked out.
    gh-release download "$repo" "$version" Lavalink.jar Lavalink.jar || fail "The download failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
fi

# A first application.yml, with a random password and the YouTube plugin
# (Lavalink's own YouTube source is retired). The port is kept up to date
# at every start; everything else is yours to change.
if [ ! -f application.yml ]; then
    password=$(head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '/+=')
    yt=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://maven.lavalink.dev/releases/dev/lavalink/youtube/youtube-plugin/maven-metadata.xml | sed -n 's:.*<release>\(.*\)</release>.*:\1:p') || yt=""
    {
        cat <<YML
server:
  port: ${SERVER_PORT:-2333}
  address: 0.0.0.0
  http2:
    enabled: false
YML
        if [ -n "$yt" ]; then
            cat <<YML
plugins:
  youtube:
    enabled: true
    allowSearch: true
    allowDirectVideoIds: true
    allowDirectPlaylistIds: true
lavalink:
  plugins:
    - dependency: "dev.lavalink.youtube:youtube-plugin:$yt"
      snapshot: false
YML
        else
            echo "lavalink:"
        fi
        cat <<YML
  server:
    password: "$password"
    sources:
      youtube: false
      bandcamp: true
      soundcloud: true
      twitch: true
      vimeo: true
      nico: true
      http: true
      local: false
    bufferDurationMs: 400
    frameBufferDurationMs: 5000
    opusEncodingQuality: 10
    resamplingQuality: LOW
    trackStuckThresholdMs: 10000
    useSeekGhosting: true
    playerUpdateInterval: 5
    youtubeSearchEnabled: true
    soundcloudSearchEnabled: true
    gc-warnings: true

metrics:
  prometheus:
    enabled: false
    endpoint: /metrics

logging:
  file:
    path: ./logs/
  level:
    root: INFO
    lavalink: INFO
  request:
    enabled: true
    includeClientInfo: true
    includeHeaders: false
    includeQueryString: true
    includePayload: true
    maxPayloadLength: 10000
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 1GB
      max-history: 30
YML
    } > application.yml
    echo "Wrote application.yml. Lavalink's password is $password (lavalink.server.password in application.yml)."
fi
echo "Installed Lavalink $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Lavalink version to install, such as 4.2.2, or latest.
